# aws-datastores

Posture of the datastores behind an API: DynamoDB PITR and deletion protection, DocDB/Neptune storage encryption, Step Functions logging - each measured from the collect dumps, never inferred.

## Detected anti-patterns

### `AF-STORE-001` — DynamoDB table has point-in-time recovery disabled (high)

`PointInTimeRecoveryStatus` absent from ENABLED means an accidental delete or corrupting write is unrecoverable past the last on-demand backup — the continuous-backups API answers it directly.

Remediation: Enable PITR (`UpdateContinuousBackups`) on tables holding state the business cannot rebuild; 35 days of rollback costs little against a lost table.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/PointInTimeRecovery.html

### `AF-STORE-002` — DynamoDB table has deletion protection off (medium)

`DeletionProtectionEnabled` false leaves the table one API call away from destruction — cheap insurance against the worst typo.

Remediation: Enable deletion protection on tables whose recreation cost exceeds the operational friction of one extra flag.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/WorkingWithTables.Basics.html

### `AF-STORE-003` — DocumentDB cluster storage is not encrypted (critical)

`StorageEncrypted: false` on a cluster holding API data means the volume at rest is plaintext-readable by anyone with storage access — the describe call declares it.

Remediation: Encryption is set at cluster creation; migrate via snapshot-restore into an encrypted cluster with a customer-managed KMS key.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/developerguide/encryption-at-rest.html

### `AF-STORE-004` — Neptune cluster storage is not encrypted (critical)

Same posture as DocumentDB — `StorageEncrypted: false` is a declared fact about the cluster, not a guess.

Remediation: Recreate the cluster encrypted (snapshot-restore migration path) with a customer-managed key.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/encrypt.html

### `AF-STORE-005` — Step Functions state machine has logging OFF (medium)

`loggingConfiguration.level: OFF` means a failed execution leaves no history beyond the console's 90-day event view — the orchestration of an API workflow becomes undebuggable.

Remediation: Set level ERROR or ALL to a CloudWatch log group with a retention sized to the incident-review window.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/cw-logs.html
